BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 289. SHANGHAI.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S S R
27th August, 1936. D. 7504
Date 30 - 8 - 36

My dear Young,
Many thanks for your Letter No.D.7504
of 21st August. I hear Honkanen is coming back
to Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,
〔此处转录不清〕

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER CRIME BRANCH）

S. C. Young, Esquire,
Shanghai.

1936 年 8 月 27 日。 D. 7504

page_data.en:
MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTRY
S. D. 2504
22 / 8 / 36

August 21 36.

My dear Barton,

With reference to your letter of August 20,
I have to inform you that Johannes Honkanen, Finn, was
born at Derijeke, Finland, on July 16, 1891. For many
years he was employed as a seaman on various vessels
and whilst passing through Shanghai on one of his numerous
voyages, he decided to join the River Police here.
He applied to the Chinese Maritime Customs and was engaged
as a Constable on probation on September 1, 1921, being
confirmed in that rank on March 12, 1922. He resigned
from the River Police on February 3, 1923, and left
Shanghai soon afterwards. He has not come to the notice
of the Police since that time. When he joined the
River Police, he gave his home address as S'Aharovankatu,
Finland.

Honkanen is reported to be an individual of
quiet and sober habits. There is nothing in the records
of the Municipal Police or River Police to the detriment
of his character.

Yours sincerely,

〔签名〕

James Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

公共租界警务处
特别分部登记处
S. D. 2504
36 年 8 月 22 日

1936 年 8 月 21 日。

亲爱的巴顿：

关于你方 8 月 20 日的来信，兹告知如下：芬兰人 Johannes Honkanen 于 1891 年 7 月 16 日出生于芬兰 Derijeke。多年来，他在多艘船只上担任海员；在他众多航次中经过上海时，他决定加入此地的水上警察部队。他向中国海关税务司提出申请，并于 1921 年 9 月 1 日被录用为试用巡捕，后于 1922 年 3 月 12 日确认为正式巡捕。他于 1923 年 2 月 3 日从水上警察部队辞职，随后不久便离开了上海。自那时起，警方未再注意到其行踪。当他加入水上警察部队时，提供的家庭住址为：芬兰 S'Aharovankatu。

据报，Honkanen 是一个习性安静、生活检点的人。在公共租界警务处或水上警察队的档案记录中，没有任何不利于其品行的记载。

此致，

〔签名〕

James Barton 先生，
英国驻华总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch - S. B. D.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / 7504 / Station 36）
Date August 21, 1936

Subject Communication dated August 20, 1936 from H.B.M. Consulate-
General regarding a Finn named Johannes HONKANEN.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J Logan O.S.I.

Johannes HONKANEN, Finn, was born at Derijoke,
Finland on July 16, 1891. For many years he was employed
as a seaman on various vessels and whilst passing through
Shanghai on one of his numerous voyages, he became obsessed
with the idea of joining the River Police here. He applied
to the Chinese Maritime Customs to join the River Police
and on September 1, 1921 was engaged as a Constable on
probation, being confirmed in that rank on March 12, 1922.
On February 3, 1923, he submitted his resignation,
which was accepted. He is reported to have been an indi-
vidual of quiet and sober habits, although shortly prior
to his resignation, he was involved in a fight in Shanghai.
There is nothing on record in the files of the S.M. Police
or River Police to the detriment of Honkanen. He left
Shanghai shortly after his resignation, since when he has
not come to the notice of this office.
His home address at the time that he became a member
of the River Police was given as: S'Aharovankatu, Finland.

（批：D&R / 21/8）

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime & Special Branches).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别分部 - S. B. D.
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别分部登记处 / 7504 / 36 站）
日期 1936 年 8 月 21 日

事由：英国总领事馆于 1936 年 8 月 20 日发来的函件，涉及一名名为 Johannes HONKANEN 的芬兰人。
由 D.S. Pitts 撰写。由 J Logan O.S.I. 转呈。

Johannes HONKANEN，芬兰人，于 1891 年 7 月 16 日出生于芬兰 Derijoke。多年来，他在多艘船只上担任海员；在他众多航次中经过上海时，他一心想加入此地的水上警察部队。他向中国海关税务司申请加入水上警察部队，并于 1921 年 9 月 1 日被录用为试用巡捕，后于 1922 年 3 月 12 日确认为正式巡捕。1923 年 2 月 3 日，他提交辞呈并获批准。据报，他习性安静、生活检点，尽管在辞职前不久，他曾卷入上海的一起斗殴事件。在上海公共租界警务处或水上警察队的档案中，没有任何不利于 Honkanen 的记录。他在辞职后不久便离开了上海，此后本处未再注意到其行踪。
他在成为水上警察队成员时提供的家庭住址为：芬兰 S'Aharovankatu。

（批注：D&R / 21/8）

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.
副总监（刑事及特别分部）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. B. R.G.
S. B. D. 7504
20 8 36
Consulate General
Shanghai.

20. 8. 36.

My dear Young,

I believe that some years ago (probably
about 12 - 15 ) a Finn named JOHANNES HUKKANEN was
employed in the Water Police. I should be most grate-
ful if I could be given details of his record out here.

Yours Sincerely,
〔签名〕

S 2 / DR

S. C. Young Esq.,
Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road.

D.S. Pitts
J.B. 20/8

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界
特别分部登记处 (S. B. R.G.)
S. B. D. 7504
36 年 8 月 20 日
总领事馆
上海。

36. 8. 20.

亲爱的杨：

我相信在几年前（大约 12 至 15 年前），一名名为 JOHANNES HUKKANEN 的芬兰人曾在水上警察部队任职。如能获知他在此地的履历详情，我将不胜感激。

此致，
〔签名〕

S 2 / DR

S. C. Young 先生，
特别分部，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路。

D.S. Pitts
J.B. 20/8

（印：副总监（刑事科））
